description: Udbuddet vedrører afhentning, behandling og afsætning af kategori 2-jord og ”uden for kategori”-jord for ordregivers Park og Vej afdeling. Jorden er materialer fra maskinfejning og brøndtømning fra offentlige veje og pladser i Viborg Kommune. Ordregiver foretager prøvetagning, analyser og kategorisering af jorden inden afhentning, og varetager selv læsning af jord med egne maskiner til leverandørens lastbil. Ordregiver har dog option på, at leverandøren foretager prøvetagning, analyser og kategorisering af jorden på ordregivers plads. Alle tilbudsgivere, som måtte ønske det, kan komme forbi Park og Vej, Katmosevej 4, 8800 Viborg, for besigtigelse af jorden. Besigtigelse foregår d. 19. oktober fra 08.30-09.30. Tilmelding til besigtigelse skal ske til: udbud@viborg.dk senest d. 16. oktober kl. 08.

title: EMBEDDING AT SCALE - EXPRO+
description: Generating embeddings for large-scale EO datasets involves significant engineering considerations: data must be efficiently pre-processed, batched, and passed through embedding models, often in HPC and other distributed systems capable to handle millions or billions of inputs. In EO, data formats, data projections, data storage and data retrieval are critical, requiring optimized techniques and tools to maintain performance and scale embedding generation to regional and global scale. In addition, ensuring generated embeddings are usable for a wide range of downstream applications and are coherently updated when new EO data is acquired are other key challenges. Several efforts in the past, such as work performed with MajorTOM in the ESA -lab, showed how these challenges can be an important limitation for scaling embeddings and AI models and ultimately fully utilize the vast amount of Earth Observation data acquired by ESA and non-ESA missions. The objective of this activity is to develop technologies, methods and tools required to establish a system capable of generating, retrieving and utilizing embeddings at regional and global scale from multimodal EO data (e.g., Sentinel missions at different product levels, VHR data, SAR data...). The activity final aim is to unlock new large-scale capabilitiesnd support the generation and utilization of embeddings of massive EO datasets for downstream application, with the final goal to democratize access to EO data, making it more usable and accessible for users with limited computational resources.

title: Support for the review by the Commission concerning the implementation of ICAO’s CORSIA, and for Commission reports on certain types of flights, social impacts, and air connectivity of islands, remote territories and Iceland
description:
Provide for support for the revision of the ETS Directive for aviaiton

This call for tender requests analytical services for the review by the Commission concerning implementation by third countries of the International Civil Aviation Organization’s (ICAO) measure ‘Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation’ (CORSIA), as required by Article 28b (2) of Directive 2003/87/EC (hereinafter, "the Directive"), and including Article 25a(7) and Article 30(8).
It also requests analysis on environmental and climate impacts, and ways to reduce those, of short-haul flights, private- and business jet flights, as defined in Article 30(8)(a) and (b) of the Directive, and as required in Article 30(8). It also requests analysis of the social impacts of this Directive and connectivity, as required by Article 30(8)(c) and (d), the latter should also take into account Iceland.

All sectors of the economy, including international aviation, need to contribute to reduce greenhouse gas emissions so that we can comply with our commitment to the temperature goals of the Paris Agreement. CO2 emissions from aviation have been included in the EU emissions trading system (EU ETS) since 2012. Since then, the scope of the EU ETS has been restricted to intra-European flights to facilitate progress at ICAO. With the revision of the EU ETS for aviation, co-legislators have tasked the Commission to report on the environmental integrity of CORSIA by 1 July 2026. The report will be accompanied by a legislative proposal, where appropriate, to amend the ETS in a way that is consistent with the Paris Agreement temperature goal, the Union’s economy-wide greenhouse gas emission reduction commitment for 2030 and climate neutrality by 2050 at the latest, and with the aim of preserving the environmental integrity and effectiveness of the Union’s climate action.

One part of this tender focuses on the analysis to support the report on environmental integrity of CORSIA, which co-legislators have tasked the Commission to provide by 1 July 2026. The successful candidate will provide analytical support for this assessment, notably an overview of implementation by third countries of CORSIA, as well how this affects general ambition in relation to targets under the Paris Agreement. 

The other part of this tender concerns analysis for certain flights. For intra-European flights between 2024-26, the European institutions have strengthened the ETS aviation rules to ensure that aviation contributes to the more ambitious target of achieving net emission reductions of at least 55% by 2030, compared to 1990 levels. The amendment of the Directive includes specific elements for the Commission to evaluate as part of its Carbon Market Report in 2026. While the Commission will carry out the evaluation independently, analysis is needed on impacts of short-haul, business- and private jet flights, as well social impacts of this Directive and air connectivity. On connectivity, the analysis should also include Iceland.

title: I-HAB Thermal Control Subsystem SCOE (TCS-SCOE)
description:
The Cislunar Gateway International Habitat (I-HAB) is ESAs contribution of an infrastructure element supporting the Gateway with full crew habitability and utilization requirements from 2025. The I-HAB includes contributions from USA, Japan and Canada. The Cislunar Gateway is a multi-element infrastructure designed to support both robotic and human exploration of cis-lunar space and act as a basecamp for sustained lunar exploration. The Lunar Gateway is smaller than the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly. It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft.
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor for Thermal Control Subsystem SCOE (TCS-SCOE)- in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.
The Thermal Control Subsystem SCOE (TCS-SCOE)-is part of the support equipment to integrate and test the I-HAB Gateway module.
The Thermal Control Subsystem SCOE (TCS-SCOE)-function is to simulate Passive TCS on I-HAB module and command & control Active TCS in dedicated test configurations
Notwithstanding the complete list of countries identified in the Special Provision for visibility purposes, the ITT letter of invitation will contain a dedicated set of geographical return requirements/targets to be considered.Further information concerning the I-HAB can be found on the Agencys website here:https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Human_and_Robotic_Exploration/Gateway_to_the_Moon

title: Finland – Medical consumables – Räätälöidyt peittely- ja toimenpidepakkaukset, DPS
description: Sansia Oy pyytää osallistumishakemuksia perustettavaan dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään (DPS), jonka kautta kilpailutetaan tilaajakohtaisesti erilaisia räätälöityjä peittely- ja toimenpidepakkauksia käytettäväksi esimerkiksi leikkaustoiminnassa, politoiminnassa sekä muissa lääketieteellisissä toimenpiteissä. Tämän DPS:n kautta voidaan kilpailuttaa kaikkien Sansian, terveydenhuollon tarvikkeita ostavien, omistaja-asiakkaiden tarpeen mukaisia räätälöityjä pakkauksia. Tällaisia omistaja-asiakkaita ovat esimerkiksi hyvinvointialueet sekä niiden ostoja hoitavat organisaatiot. Ajantasainen omista-asiakkaiden listaus löytyy Sansian kotisivuilta. Selvennykseksi todetaan, että tämä järjestelmä tulee jatkossa korvaamaan tällä hetkellä voimassa olevan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän: 473264 / Osallistumispyyntö: Räätälöityjä peittely- ja toimenpidepakkauksia koskeva dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä. Hankintajärjestelmään voi hakeutua tarjoajaksi koko järjestelmän voimassaoloajan jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen tähän osallistumispyyntöön. Järjestelmään hakeutuminen ei tarkoita suoraan osallistumista kilpailutettaviin hankintoihin, vaan tarjoajan tulee järjestelmään hyväksymisen jälkeen erikseen jättää tarjous avattaviin kilpailutuksiin. Hankintasopimuskohtaiset vaatimukset, kuvaukset ja muut asiakirjat ovat nähtävillä kilpailutuksen avaushetkellä dynaamiseen järjestelmään hyväksytyille toimijoille. Voimassa oleviin sopimuksiin eli jo kilpailutettuihin hankintoihin ei voi jättää tarjousta ennen kuin kilpailutus avataan uudelleen. Kilpailutettavat tuotteet, tuotteille asetettavat vähimmäisvaatimukset ja muut hankinnan kohteeseen liittyvät vaatimukset ja muut ehdot sekä tilaajat määritellään erikseen jokaisessa hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä tarjouspyynnössä. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän suunniteltu päättymispäivä on 31.1.2030.
